capabilities.name: Assumption & Uncertainty Intelligence
capabilities.grounding: MODEL/FIXTURE GROUNDED on /executive; PARTIALLY GROUNDED in EI:3 tests via Data Reality handoff
capabilities.exiDependency: EXI assigns independent epistemic labels (fact/relationship/assumption/prediction/unknown) and Advisor evidenceState (strong/limited/incomplete/stale/none)
capabilities.notes: Canonical FACT|ASSUMPTION|PREDICTION|UNKNOWN exists. Core does not classify an arbitrary executive claim; the caller labels type. FACT requires evidence+provenance. /executive never calls createExecutiveClaim.

capabilities.name: Causal Intelligence
capabilities.coreAuthority: EI:3 EvidenceBoundedRelationship (observed-relationship | possible-contributor | supported-causal | unknown-cause); infersCausality=false
capabilities.exiDependency: EXI:2 maps unlabeled fixture edges to contributor copy; primaryContributor only if exactly one inbound link
capabilities.notes: Core can record causal-support kinds when a caller supplies them. Core cannot infer cause, rank contributors by evidence, or distinguish RELATED vs CAUSAL on /executive fixture edges (those edges have no supportKind).

capabilities.name: Constraint Intelligence
capabilities.coreAuthority: none single; EI:3 ExecutiveConstraintReference (non-live) + Stage constrained-by/blocks + CC:8 assessment constraints
capabilities.exiDependency: EXI:2 lists constrained-by and blocks; bindingConstraint always null
capabilities.notes: No binding-constraint reasoner. No constraint-relief downstream reasoning. Listing recorded relation kinds is not Constraint Intelligence.

capabilities.name: Priority Intelligence
capabilities.coreAuthority: EI:4 resolveExplainablePriority (non-live); live attention from Stage fixture ATTENTION_RANK, Queue, NBA, Advisor
capabilities.exiDependency: EXI presents attention/recommendation copy; does not rank competing problems with grounded criteria
capabilities.notes: EI:4 can explain high/medium/low from supplied PriorityFactors with numericalScore always null. /executive does not consume it. overviewAttentionItems sorts fixtures by attention then id.

capabilities.name: Trade-off Intelligence
capabilities.grounding: MODEL/FIXTURE GROUNDED on /executive (scenario fixture summaries); EI:4 tests use constructed claims
capabilities.exiDependency: EXI:3 extracts qualitative gain/risk/constraint/assumption phrases from existing scenario summaries; ei4LiveOnExecutive=false
capabilities.notes: EI:4 output is qualitative gain/sacrifice strings plus evidenceRefs, not a quantitative economics model. Missing runtime binding: EI:4 → (no nex-mvp reader) → /executive.

depth.notes: EI:3 detects claim type only if caller labels it; semantic confidence from evidence overlap. No propagation Data→Problem→Scenario→Recommendation→Decision. No learning of confidence.
Detect/explain = recorded relationships. EXI:2 chain is fixture-edge walk. Ranking if count===1 is not causal ranking.
Detect = list constrained-by/blocks. No binding, no relief prediction.
Live rank is fixture attention sort. EI:4 can compare supplied factors in tests only. Cannot explain Address B first because… on /executive.
EI:4 compare exists off-path. Live EXI:3 compares explored-by siblings from summary copy. No quantitative predict/rank.
